formal_statement: ¬ (∃ (x1 : ℕ), ∀ (x2 : ℕ) (x3 : SimpleGraph (Fin x2)) [x4 : DecidableRel x3.Adj], (∀ (x5 : Fin x2) (x6 : x3.Walk x5 x5), x6.IsCycle → (5 : ℕ) ≤ x6.length) → x3.edgeFinset.Nonempty → ∀ (x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x8 : SimpleGraph (Fin x2)), PEqualNP.TopForm.IsLeastAO x3 x7 → PEqualNP.TopForm.TopForm x3 x7 → x8 ≤ x3.deleteEdges ↑(PEqualNP.TopForm.starEdges x3 x7) → (∀ (x12 : Fin x2), (x8.neighborSet x12).ncard = (0 : ℕ) ∨ (3 : ℕ) ≤ (x8.neighborSet x12).ncard) → x8.edgeSet.ncard ≤ x1 * (x7.size + (1 : ℕ)))
plain_statement: It is false that: There is a constant c such that: if G has an edge and no cycle shorter than 5, C is a least top-form circuit of AND and OR gates each reading exactly two earlier wires computing G's edge function, and H is a subgraph of G whose edges are no top's cross pair and whose every vertex has degree 0 or at least 3, then H has at most c times (size of C + 1) edges.
